name: table-global-3d-ar-preview
title: Add global table 3D and AR preview
description: Add one manager-level preview modal for choosing existing, online, or uploaded table models and checking them in camera AR without attaching data to a concrete table.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: This is a session/catalog preview flow only. It reuses the existing catalog, URL import, authenticated GLB upload, camera fallback and model-viewer native AR. It must not restore per-table visualConfig persistence or AR-derived floor coordinates.
